title: Deploy reviewed fleet updates for 2026-09-13
description:
STATUS: DEPLOYED AND VERIFIED on 2026-09-13. The user explicitly approved the upgrade after a fresh Immich backup. Both reviewed fleet builds were completed before activation; Mini switched first, then Baymax. Successful final nh switches used OMP foreground console PTYs.

Live fleet: Mini /nix/store/2z5qwgpk45sbk37hg4myp5xkkzxzys69-darwin-system-26.11.4cff07d; Baymax /nix/store/33q9gc4si0rbki2vfkf05adr513jnfjz-nixos-system-baymax-26.11.20260911.eaad089. Immich responds with pong and version 3.2.0. Database counts before/after match exactly: assets 11092, users 1, albums 6, people 233, faces 5635. All 11092 original paths existed before the upgrade. No optional face-cluster reset was run. Baymax pools are healthy; final failed-unit list is empty; the configured application, tunnel, WARP, SSH and Syncthing services are active. Mini Hjem launchd job exits 0. Photos returned HTTP 200 through local LAN DNS and HTTP 403 when forced to the public Cloudflare edge.

Recovery point: immich-preupgrade-20260913T180800Z. Immich was stopped for the backup. Custom-format database dump and PostgreSQL globals are in /persist/save/immich/backups/immich-preupgrade-20260913T180800Z. The dump was fully restored into a scratch database, count-compared, and the scratch database removed. SHA256: immich.dump 0fbf1fcb5e6b9c341c138ee10f035de1b9c89eae0b64c97cc11c1f8d9312edb5; globals.sql 23eed745a33f180b6aa9ff498f6614286a11c3eca09fe79e7debeee1dcf955d7. Both files were extracted from the dedicated off-site Borg archive to a hash stream and matched local hashes. Archive fingerprint 1afd540e09ff08702a0283ca024e212ae330b919d624c8e3191c0d39625fa644; 43073 files, 70.66 GB. ZFS snapshots data/persistSave@immich-preupgrade-20260913T180800Z and archive/media@immich-preupgrade-20260913T180800Z both have the immich-upgrade hold. Keep the archive, snapshots and holds until deliberately released.

Activation recovery: Hjem had obsolete SKILL.md leaf records after directory symlinks were already installed. Verified both parent targets against the generated manifest, preserved ~/Library/Application Support/Hjem/manifest.preupgrade-20260913.json, removed only the two obsolete records, and successfully reran Hjem and the full Mini switch. Syncthing initialization failed once and recovered after a clean restart; exact cause remains open in nixos-config-3e52. The unrelated full-Borg Hister warning is tracked in nixos-config-ef8f.

The requested OMP terminal-policy changes are committed and tested separately in 7ecf593, but their Mini activation timed out at the sudo prompt before applying anything. Resume nixos-config-a4e7 when the user can authenticate. This does not undo or block the completed fleet package upgrade. Root sessions were exited, sudo credentials invalidated locally/remotely, and the agent-created Herdr tab closed.

Historical predeployment review (the HOLD below was resolved by the explicit approval, verified backup, and deployment above):

STATUS: HOLD. Review branch updates/fleet-2026-09-13 refreshes all flake inputs (9 moved) and custom package pins: Hunk 0.22.0, OMP/relay 18.1.19, Plannotator 0.27.14, CUA Driver 0.28.1, Herdr Annotate 0.4.0 with offline Rust runtime 0.1.0, rootshell-notify 0.2.9. Nixpkgs advances d6524aa to eaad089; Homebrew taps include Helium 0.17.0.1, ChatGPT 26.908.40834, Mole 1.54.0. Remaining custom sources were audited and already current. Stable pins remain stable; no prereleases selected. Both review builds passed: Mini /nix/store/2z5qwgpk45sbk37hg4myp5xkkzxzys69-darwin-system-26.11.4cff07d via nh darwin build; Baymax /nix/store/33q9gc4si0rbki2vfkf05adr513jnfjz-nixos-system-baymax-26.11.20260911.eaad089 built on Baymax. Both closure diffs reviewed. nix flake check --no-build --all-systems passed, including all four NixOS configurations and both architecture dev shells. Changed custom packages passed targeted builds/CLI smokes; Hunk pager exercised with a piped diff. No activation, Homebrew upgrade, data migration, desktop action, or service restart performed. HOLD: https://github.com/immich-app/immich/issues/31485 remains open for reported data loss on 3.1.0 to 3.2.0; maintainer bo0tzz suspects storage, not an established upgrade defect. Re-review resolution and current backups before approval; keep off main because Baymax autoUpgrade follows the default branch. Immich optional cluster-group face reset erases names/birth dates; do not enable implicitly. Version 3.2.0 source now validates maintenance continue URLs through Route.continue despite stale no-patched-version advisory metadata (GHSA-h5w4-vjv4-9r5q). OpenSSL 3.6.4 includes Moderate-or-lower security fixes. Plannotator fixes document symlink escape (#1437), but its local-server authentication issue #956 remains open. OMP tool-restriction issue #11032 remains open. CUA native-window SDK change was breaking upstream; package/serve/MCP command surfaces checked, desktop permissions and live GUI require approved deployment verification. Herdr Annotate offline manifest and native runtime checked, not live pane interaction. Preserve private/Access-gated services. Before either switch, confirm the final committed closures and obtain explicit fleet deployment approval; Mini first, then Baymax in an interactive PTY.

title: Back up Hister SQLite from a consistent snapshot
description: Observed during the approved 2026-09-13 fleet deployment: the full borgbackup-job-hetzner run at 11:09:19 PDT exited 1 because /persist/save/hister/vectors.sqlite3 changed while Borg read it. Archive baymax-hetzner-2026-09-13T11:09:19.failed was retained. This was not an Immich backup failure: the separate immich-preupgrade-20260913T180800Z archive completed cleanly, and its database dump and globals were read back with matching hashes. Decide the correct consistency contract for Hister SQLite/vector data and implement a consistent backup source rather than suppressing Borg warnings. No Hister backup configuration was changed during the fleet upgrade.

title: Diagnose Syncthing default-config startup during switch
description: During the 2026-09-13 11:33 PDT Baymax switch to eaad089, Syncthing 2.1.3 (Go 1.26.7) logged Default config saved and archived config.xml.v0, then rejected Mini as unknown. syncthing-init failed with CSRF Error and jq status 5. The host config at /persist/save/syncthing/config/config.xml remained 9238 bytes, dated 2026-09-09, version 52 with 2 devices and 1 folder. Host/PID1/sandbox stat views agreed. Syncthing was stopped because defaults enabled discovery/relays contrary to the managed policy. A network-isolated copy-config/empty-database run loaded the correct peer and loopback listener. A subsequent clean start of syncthing-init succeeded; authenticated API worked, Mini connected, and a complete nh os switch then exited successfully. Exact switch-time cause remains unproven. Investigate before changing startup ordering, filesystem settings, or adding retries. Current running configuration is correct and no temporary overrides remain.

description: Blocked on user authentication, not on implementation.
